searched: I searched for generator fleets at the Red Wolf campus in Wyandotte County, the Google and Meta campuses at Kansas City and the Flint Hills Digital Campus at Emporia, using the state air permit notices, county and city records and press. Only Sherlock has a permit with generators.

monitor.monitor_reason: A proposed gigawatt scale data center campus near Emporia says it will use some on-site generation, but no fuel, unit or capacity is named.
monitor.note: Data Center Dynamics reported on June 22, 2026 that Kanza Park Place LLC proposed a campus of up to 1,000 acres in Lyon County near Emporia, with a combination of dedicated grid service and on-site generation. A television station report of June 2, 2026 covers the same proposal. The city approved zoning in July 2026 and said it was a land use decision only. No source names a fuel, a turbine or engine, a capacity or an air permit. I found no air permit notice for it. It becomes an add when a document names gas or diesel generating units.

verifications.note: Names Kanza Park Place and on-site generation.
Names the Flint Hills Digital Campus at Emporia.
